spans.s: hema (IE 8-1), abbreviation of hemanta. See also hema-dhānyaka.
hema , same as māṣa; cf. hema-dhānyaka.
hemadhānyaka, same as māṣa (JNSI, Vol. XVI, p. 45); sometimes hema or dhānaka is used in the same sense (ibid., p. 44).
hema-dhānyaka , same as māṣa; see hema and dhānaka.
hema-garbha (EI 12, 16; SII 3), name of a mahādāna; same as hiraṇya-garbha.
hema-ṭaṅka, ‘a gold ṭaṅka (q. v.)’. See JNSI, Vol. XXII, p. 197.
hemidrachma (IE 8-8), name of a Greek coin.
hemi-drachma , Greek; same as Sanskrit dramm-ārdha (q. v.); see drachma, dramma, etc.
